description: This file implements logic for managing a command to execute a Pi runtime, including resolving the command path, handling environment variables, ensuring the runtime is installed, and managing its execution context.

classes.name: docsPiCommand
classes.description: Struct representing the command to execute the Pi runtime, including the executable path and arguments.

methods.name: resolveDocsPiCommand
methods.description: Resolves the command for the Pi runtime, considering environment variables, system path, and whether to materialize the runtime.

methods.name: shouldMaterializePiRuntime
methods.description: Determines if the Pi runtime needs to be materialized based on its path.

methods.name: ensureMaterializedPiRuntime
methods.description: Ensures that the Pi runtime is installed and ready, installing it if necessary.

methods.name: getMaterializedPiRuntimeDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path where the materialized Pi runtime resides, based on cache directories.

methods.name: getMaterializedPiPackageVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the package version for the Pi runtime, either from environment or default.
